feeds.title: LSE Blog
feeds.description: Browse our posts on European Politics and Policy. Our latest posts cover the Energy Crisis, Elections, and Russia-Ukraine War among many other relevant topics. EUROPP - European Politics and Policy is a multidisciplinary academic blog run by the London School of Economics and Political Science with an aim to increase public understanding of European politics and policy.

feeds.title: CNBC » Europe Politics
feeds.description: Get complete CNBC business news coverage on European Politics. Find the latest business news pertaining to Europe. CNBC.com is the preeminent financial news source on the web, featuring an unprecedented amount of video, real-time market analysis, web-exclusive live video, and analytical financial tools.

feeds.title: UCL Europe Blog » Politics & Governance
feeds.description: The UCL European Institute's blog is a space for analysis and commentary on a range of Europe-related topics from UCL academics and other experts. feeds.title: The Loop
feeds.description: The Loop by ECPR publishes short pieces on politics, policy programs, and societal and political issues. We showcase the work of the political science discipline at its best. Read Articles dissecting an academic journal paper, or analyzing a topical news story from a political science perspective.

feeds.title: The European Sting
feeds.description: The European Sting is a new Media Project that was born out of the need to find a solution to the lack of insightful and independent news services in Europe. The European Sting publishes Critical News & Insights on European Politics, Economy, Foreign Affairs, Business & Technology, and many globally relevant topics.

feeds.title: POLITICO
feeds.description: POLITICO Europe covers the politics, policy, and personalities of the European Union. Our coverage includes breaking news, opinion pieces, and features. POLITICO is a global nonpartisan politics and policy news organization, launched in Europe and accurately provides real-time policy intelligence service for professionals.

feeds.title: The Euroculturer
feeds.description: Explore articles focusing on European Politics, Culture, and Society. The Euroculturer is a project run by students. We conduct interviews, write opinion articles, and help students and alumni publish their own pieces. We work closely together with the Social Media team to provide the best quality content to our readers.

feeds.title: Poultry Business Magazine » EU & Politics

Poultry Business provides news, comment, and analysis, as well as prices and market information.

feeds.title: Euro Prospects
feeds.description: Euro Prospects is a news outlet which strives to be a center for open discussion on European politics, policy, and prospects with a goal to inform on pressing European topics while offering a platform for people to express their views on present and prospective Europe.

feeds.title: Eyes on Europe » European Politics
feeds.description: Discover eye-opening commentary, interview,s and opinion pieces on European Politics. Eyes on Europe is a non-profit association (ASBL) that publishes a biannual magazine and weekly online articles focusing on European issues. We also regularly organize conferences and debates with researchers, European officials, or sometimes just students to better understand EU issues.

feeds.title: Fair Observer » European Politics News
feeds.description: Fair Observer's European Political News section captures the latest European politics news & analysis, news this week, Europe terrorism, EU migrant crisis, Syrian war & latest on European affairs. feeds.title: EU Political Report
feeds.description: Stay with us to find all national and international information about Europe and the World. Read News about economy, politics, diplomacy, and others.
